description: Header file defining the torch::jit::CompilationUnit class and related structures for managing JIT compilation units, functions, and classes within the PyTorch JIT compiler.

classes.name: torch::jit::CompilationUnit
classes.description: Manages a collection of functions and classes for JIT compilation, including function lookup, definition, and type registration.

classes.name: torch::jit::Self
classes.description: Abstract interface for self-referential objects within the JIT compilation context.

classes.name: torch::jit::StrongFunctionPtr
classes.description: Smart pointer pairing a Function with its owning CompilationUnit.

methods.name: find_function
methods.description: Finds a function by its qualified name within the compilation unit.

methods.name: get_function
methods.description: Retrieves a function by name, throws if not found.

methods.name: set_optimized
methods.description: Deprecated method to set optimization; no longer has effect.

methods.name: define
methods.description: Defines functions from source or definitions, returning list of created functions.

methods.name: create_function
methods.description: Creates a new function with a given graph and name.

methods.name: get_functions
methods.description: Returns all functions in the compilation unit.

methods.name: run_method
methods.description: Runs a specified method with given arguments.

methods.name: drop_all_functions
methods.description: Clears all functions from the compilation unit.

methods.name: register_type
methods.description: Registers a new class type with the compilation unit.

methods.name: get_class
methods.description: Retrieves a class type by name.

methods.name: get_interface
methods.description: Retrieves an interface type by name.

methods.name: get_named_tuple
methods.description: Retrieves a named tuple type by name.

methods.name: unsafeRemoveMethod
methods.description: Removes a method internally, used for freezing.

methods.name: mangle
methods.description: Generates a unique qualified name to avoid conflicts.
